culinary.title: Nasi Goreng Luwih
culinary.description: Experience the bold flavors of Bali with our fragrant fried rice, wok-tossed in a traditional 'Base Genep' spice paste. This authentic, spicy dish is infused with aromatic lemongrass, shrimp paste, and bird's eye chilies. Served with a crispy fried egg, traditional chicken sate lilit, crunchy prawn crackers, and fresh pickled vegetables (acar).

culinary.title: Hot Coffee Latte
culinary.description: A smooth and velvety balance of rich, full-bodied espresso and creamy steamed milk. Finished with a delicate layer of silky micro-foam and topped with exquisite, handcrafted latte art for a perfect morning or afternoon pick-me-up.

culinary.title: Chiken Cordon Bleu
culinary.description: Golden-brown breaded chicken breast stuffed with premium smoked beef and melted mozzarella cheese.

culinary.title: Milo Dinosaur
culinary.description: A rich, chilled chocolate malt drink topped with extra Milo powder.

culinary.title: Classic Cheese Burger
culinary.description: A juicy, flame-grilled beef patty topped with melted cheddar cheese, crisp lettuce, fresh tomato slices, and tangy pickles on a toasted sesame brioche bun. Finished with our signature house sauce for the ultimate savory bite.

culinary.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
culinary.description: Classic al dente spaghetti tossed in a rich, velvety sauce of eggs and aged Parmesan cheese. Topped with extra crispy pancetta, a crack of fresh black pepper, and a touch of chopped parsley for a perfectly balanced savory finish.

culinary.title: Happy Chiken n Fries
culinary.description: Two juicy, premium chicken sausages grilled to perfection and served with a mountain of golden, crispy french fries. A classic kid-approved favorite that's big on flavor and perfect for little appetites!

culinary.title: Crispy Nugget n Fries Adventure
culinary.description: Bite-sized, golden chicken nuggets with a satisfying crunch, served alongside a generous portion of our famous crispy french fries. Perfectly portioned for little explorers and served with a side of classic tomato ketchup for dipping fun!

culinary.title: Rice Bowl Chiken Teriyaki
culinary.description: Tender, juicy grilled chicken glazed in a rich and glossy authentic teriyaki sauce. Served over a bed of fluffy steamed white rice, accompanied by fresh sautéed vegetables, and topped with a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions for an extra layer of flavor.

offers.description: Coffee + Meal for your work session.
